shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files | head -50
cat src/*.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu && ls; cat DropdownMenu.d.ts types.d.ts; sed -n 1,200p README.md 2>/dev/null | head -150; ls ../../../../ | head; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -E "^(Pencil|Copy|TrashBin|Ellipsis|ChevronDown|ArrowShapeTurnUpRight|Archive)\.js"; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40

node -e "const f='package.json';const p=require('./'+f);p.dependencies={'@gravity-ui/icons':'^2.23.0',...p.dependencies};require('fs').writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n')" && cat package.json && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
rm -rf dist && (ls node_modules | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|happy-dom"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null) || echo none
